data.one_liner: A drop-in replacement for the Flutter Tooltip supporting Markdown content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized tooltip widget that renders Markdown-formatted text inside the popup. It introduces a default delay to prevent immediate visual clutter.
use_when: You want tooltips that support bold, italics, or other markdown styling.
You need a drop-in replacement for standard tooltips with built-in markdown parsing.
avoid_when: You need complex text selection inside the tooltip.
You require features not supported by the underlying markdown implementation.
strengths: Easy drop-in usage wrapping existing widgets
Includes default delay configuration to avoid UI clutter
weaknesses: Text selection and URL links may have limited support depending on version
data.minimal_example:
MarkdownTooltip(
    message: '**Save** Tap here to save.',
    child: Icon(Icons.save),
)
